note: RESEARCH_COMPLETE_NO_PRODUCTIZATION. Stage 1 OpenAI answered the research question (NO_MEANINGFUL_REPEATABLE_DIFFERENCE). Not failed. No production Query-Origin dimension. Stage 2 Claude NOT_PLANNED. Capability retained for future reopen.

another asset geography shows a stronger hypothesis
future monitoring detects unexplained regional response differences

geographicModel.ASSET_GEOGRAPHY: Where the hotel / development project is located (e.g. Mexico, CALA, Europe). Controlled constant in this experiment.
geographicModel.QUERY_ORIGIN_GEOGRAPHY: Hypothetical decision-maker / asker market cohort (e.g. US_NORTHEAST). Experimental variable.
geographicModel.PROVIDER_LOCATION_CONTEXT: Governed location payload passed to provider search/localization APIs (city/region/country/timezone or latLng). Must not be simulated by rewriting prompt text.

rationale: High Dealality commercial relevance and existing EN/ES Mexico prompt coverage in governed showcase/presence pools
Strong international owner/developer interest from both U.S. and European information ecosystems
Country-scope Mexico prompts already exist as a distinct cohort (not rolled into headline CALA regional metrics)
Enables identical Asset Geography while varying only Query-Origin / Provider Location Context

promptFamilies: Development Strategy / new-build positioning (Mexico-governed twin where available)

promptSelectionRules.source: Existing governed owner-intent prompts (Airtable AI Visibility - Prompts / showcase seed) — Mexico asset geography only
promptSelectionRules.note: Final 8–10 family IDs locked at execution gate after Presence certification; prefer Mexico twins with EN+ES. Do not invent new prompt wording in v1.

languages.rule: EN and ES are separate controlled cohorts. Same exact EN string across all four origins; same exact ES string across all four origins. Do not origin-specific translate.

repetition.rationale: LLM outputs are probabilistic; single-shot origin vs origin is insufficient to claim observed query-origin difference. Three repeats per prompt×provider×language×origin is the minimum bounded design.
